name: wan-2-2-ti2v-5b
license: Apache-2.0 (free for personal and commercial use)

resources.videoSecondsTypical: ~60-120s per 5-7s clip on RTX 4090; ~150-240s on RTX 4080

notes: Combined text-to-video + image-to-video, 5B parameters, runs comfortably on 16GB consumer GPUs. The right Wan choice for tenants on consumer hardware. Higher-quality A14B variants are documented in sibling manifests but need 24GB+ VRAM. Apache 2.0 unrestricted commercial use. No audio path — pair with stable-audio-3 if you need background music, or use the ltx-video runner for synchronized audio+video in one model. Dimensions must be divisible by 16 (the runner clamps automatically).
